notes.title: [SWITCH RELEASE] 1917DX now on Nintendo Switch
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25278949/ab823bcf5e5f89139f15a85b3ba2dffad98605e6.jpg[/img]

Korion and Andrade Games join forces to bring „1917 – The Alien Invasion DX“ to Nintendo Switch this week  

Ludwigsburg, 18 June, 2018 — Korion Games published the release date for the Nintendo Switch version of Andrade Games‘ genre jewel “1917 – The Alien Invasion DX”         
 
A feast for nostalgics and a furious ride for beginners of the genre: The newest rendition of this memorization “Bullet Hell” shooter presents itself in a completely new light on the Nintendo Switch. With special adaptations for the portable system and the addition of a cooperative multiplayer, it also packs a lot more content than the initial release two years ago. "I am glad to see 1917 DX on Nintendo Switch - the ultimate Shoot 'em Up machine.“, developer Sebastian De Andrade says, hinting at the origins of the genre on Nintendo platforms.
All levels come with increasing difficulty and with a boss fight at the end - the heart of the game. Different airships, weapon types and special attacks are necessary to successfully stop the alien invasion. The more numerous the masses of annihilated alien adversaries are, the more glorious the victory is scored.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25278949/4057066ee3c7f55025aff3c2c510b6b033cfe955.png[/img]

This release on Nintendo Switch is now the definitive edition of the game that both challenges hardcore players and, with the help of the coop mode, also helps beginners entering the genre. "It is a challenging game, but with enough patience and level memorization you will beat it", Andrade emphasizes. The NIntendo Switch version will be available in Europe, Australia and North America on 22 June, 2018.

Andrade Games is an independent developer that is known for classic games in the shooter/platformer genre, that provide a well-designed game experience, unique settings and that put memorable and unusual heroes in the spotlight.

Korion Games is an independent developer and publisher for PC, consoles and mobile platforms. Their strengths lie in strategy games and platformers and in porting games to consoles. Since 2013 the company is active in providing games for entertainment and education and particularly experienced in performance-oriented development in Unity. More info on www.korion.de.

notes.title: [Music Trailer] SturmFront The Mutant War: Übel Edition
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25278949/8ac476c5ba3ac5d53b02ace8f3d96b0ca6df5efd.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ie7jIFCx988] Metal Trailer	[/url]

The German Crust Metal band Hellknife releases a new music video in cooperation with the German indie game developer Sebastian de Andrade.

Both are living in the area around Mannheim and both are into uncompromising art. While Hellknife is playing hardcore Heavy Metal, the game studio Andrade Games is producing classic shooting games in the style of the 90s arcade machines.

Indie developer Sebastian de Andrade tells:
"I saw Hellknife at the Rhein Neckar Metal Festival X and was instantly enthusiastic about that we are speaking the same artistic language. Their newest cover artwork shows the Mannheim water tower, skulls and a heavy tank, and I immediately realized that we had to carry out a joint project, because one level of my current game "SturmFront - The Mutant War: Übel Edition" takes place in Mannheim.” 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25278949/f125a04ef167fbd42b4913a59df1d3b19897133c.png[/img]

"SturmFront The Mutant War: Übel Edition" is the 2nd game by developer studio Andrade Games, set to release on August 11th. It is a sequel to the 2016 shoot 'em up game "1917 - The Alien Invasion DX", which is also available on Steam. 


In addition Hellknife singer Ralf Keitel:

"Arcade action games and Crust / D Beat music match perfectly through the energy and hardness of the two art forms. When Sebastian asked us if we would make our music available for his new game, we were like fire and flame. Our expectations have been surpassed: it is a perfect symbiosis of handmade music and handmade graphics. "

Hellknife is active since 2015 and publish their music on Bandcamp.de. Their newest album is even available as vinyl: [url=https://hellknife.bandcamp.com/] Hellknife-Homepage [/url]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25278949/3fe58c7af7874858b8f2ca53c26e4cd973faf1ac.png[/img]

Regarding Heavy Metal, Sebastian de Andrade said:
"I love Heavy Metal and classic action games, but since I do not have the talent to play a guitar, I 
am developing my very personal kind of Heavy Metal as a programmer and comic artist."

Hellknife will perform on Sunday the 6th of August with the Grindcore giants "Napalm Death" in Weinheim.

notes.title: New Artwork
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25278949/03200cd7ae1f52763cf0674c2380a0e2e91f72ed.png[/img]

Creating an artwork for a game is a very difficult task. You have to ask yourself, what is the essence of the game. Then you have to communicate it to your painter. Thanks god there are people out there who feel the same fire like me. This masterpiece is made by the Heavy Metal artist Alex Boca. He understands Heavy Metal, he understands Arcade gaming and he understands the beauty of soldiers charging into the plasma fire that will vaporize them.

I am so bored by rendered cover artworks, the whole CGI stuff. I am more into the classic approach. Alex told me it was a pleasure for him to paint this battle scene and you see his [i]Herzblut[/i] (Heart Blood) in every detail. Yes, it is made digital with a tool called Photoshop, but he didn't used many layers, there are many classic painting techniques that were also used by the old masters.

His classic way to produce art fits perfectly my classic way to develop games.
